description: This file defines the DefaultNotesRepository class, which implements the NotesRepository interface to manage note data, including CRUD operations, synchronization with remote API, and observing note status changes. It interacts with local DAOs and remote API to handle note storage, search, deletion, and sync process.

classes.name: DefaultNotesRepository
classes.description: A repository class managing notes' data, synchronization, and observing changes, bridging local database access and remote API interactions.

methods.name: observeSyncStatus
methods.description: Returns a StateFlow indicating the current synchronization status.

methods.name: observeNotes
methods.description: Returns a Flow of notes filtered by a search query, supporting full-text search.

methods.name: observeNote
methods.description: Returns a Flow of a specific note given its ID.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with the specified title and content, returning the note ID.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note with new title and content, preserving creation timestamp.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Marks a note as deleted (tombstone) for synchronization purposes.

methods.name: triggerManualSync
methods.description: Manually triggers the synchronization process and updates sync status.

methods.name: syncNow
methods.description: Performs an immediate synchronization of local and remote notes, including upload of local changes and download of remote updates.
